name: feat-2890-analytic
title: #2890 round 2 — analytic solves off the page: the page answers while it computes, the figure comes before its values (PR, port 5189)

cases.title: The slow rhombus: the figure appears at once, the values follow, and the page answers meanwhile
lines: מרחק נקודה O מהצלע DA הוא √5
cases.lookFor: Type the first four lines. Type the fifth and press Enter: the rhombus is redrawn within a moment, and the values in the panel on the left read «בודק…» for about 4 seconds, then fill in. Meanwhile scroll the page and open «מדריך»: they answer at once. Then type the sixth line: the same, about 6 seconds.
cases.before: On prod the page freezes for about 4 s (line 5) and 6 s (line 6): nothing moves, and the figure and the values appear together at the end.

cases.title: An ordinary figure, «בטל» and «בצע שוב»
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, the segment AB drawn.

cases.title: The values arrive: a point's coordinates in the panel
cases.lookFor: The panel reads A = (1, 2) and B = (4, 6); no «בודק…» left.

cases.title: A contradicted length is still refused
cases.lookFor: «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: «AB = 7»»; three rows.

cases.title: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» changes the figure
cases.lookFor: The press moves C to another place.

cases.title: A row ticked off and on
cases.lookFor: Three rows, the segment drawn again.

cases.title: Deleting a row and «בטל»
cases.lookFor: The third row goes and comes back; three rows.

cases.title: A locus question still traces its curve
lines: דרך E עובר ישר l1 מקביל לציר ה-x
G נקודת החיתוך של הישר l1 עם הישר l2
cases.lookFor: The locus chip on G's row is pressed: the parabola G traces is drawn, and the ask row names it.
